b1-precolombina-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Before 1492
b1-precolombina-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have visited a museum about the Americas before 1492, and he asks what the peoples there had already achieved when the Europeans arrived.
b1-precolombina-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what the peoples of the Americas had already done by the time the Europeans arrived.
cues: Say that the peoples of the Americas had already domesticated two crops
b1-precolombina-01.target: Cuando llegaron los europeos, los pueblos americanos ya habían domesticado el maíz y la papa.
b1-precolombina-01.english: When the Europeans arrived, the peoples of the Americas had already domesticated maize and the potato.
b1-precolombina-01.canDo: I can say what had already happened by 1492, using the past perfect.

b1-precolombina-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Quipus in the Andes
b1-precolombina-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have seen a quipu in a museum, and she asks how people in the Andes kept accounts.
b1-precolombina-02.prompt: Tell Meg what was used to keep accounts in the Andes.
cues: Say what was used and what it was for
b1-precolombina-02.target: En los Andes se usaban quipus para llevar las cuentas.
b1-precolombina-02.english: In the Andes, quipus were used to keep accounts.
b1-precolombina-02.canDo: I can say what was built, used or founded, using se + verb.

b1-precolombina-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Inca ruler
b1-precolombina-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have watched a documentary about the Inca state, and he asks who ruled it.
b1-precolombina-03.prompt: Tell Carlos who ruled the Inca state and where he governed from.
cues: Say who the head of the state was
Add that he governed from Cuzco
b1-precolombina-03.target: El Inca, que gobernaba desde Cuzco, era el jefe del Estado.
b1-precolombina-03.english: The Inca, who ruled from Cuzco, was the head of the state.
b1-precolombina-03.canDo: I can add information about a person with a relative clause (que).

b1-precolombina-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Farming in Mesoamerica
b1-precolombina-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have read a book about everyday life before 1492, and she asks what farmers in Mesoamerica grew.
b1-precolombina-04.prompt: Tell Meg what farmers in Mesoamerica used to grow.
b1-precolombina-04.target: Los campesinos solían cultivar maíz, frijol y calabaza.
b1-precolombina-04.english: Farmers used to grow maize, beans and squash.
b1-precolombina-04.canDo: I can say what people used to do, using soler.

b1-precolombina-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Maya codices
b1-precolombina-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have gone to a class about the Maya, and he asks how many Maya books have survived.
b1-precolombina-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the specialists say about the Maya codices.
b1-precolombina-05.target: Según los especialistas, solo se conservan cuatro códices mayas.
b1-precolombina-05.english: According to the specialists, only four Maya codices survive.
b1-precolombina-05.canDo: I can report what experts say, using según and indican que.

b1-precolombina-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Americas before 1492
b1-precolombina-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just watched a documentary about the Americas before 1492, and he asks what you learned.
b1-precolombina-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what the archaeologists say about the first peoples and what they had achieved by 1492.
cues: Say where the first peoples came from, naming the source
Say what the peoples of America had already created by 1492
b1-precolombina-consolidation.target: Según los arqueólogos, los primeros pueblos llegaron desde Asia. Cuando llegaron los europeos, los pueblos americanos ya habían creado muchas culturas.
b1-precolombina-consolidation.english: According to the archaeologists, the first peoples came from Asia. When the Europeans arrived, the peoples of the Americas had already created many cultures.
b1-precolombina-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about the first peoples, the great civilisations and how we know about them.
